description: This file is an HTML webpage implementing the user interface for a database visualizer. It includes styles and scripts for browsing databases, tables, and displaying table data interactively.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by reloading data from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles expansion of a database's table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display table data in a grid.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Formats individual cell data for display, handling objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content or truncated view.
